title: 题型与评分要点
goal: 判断面试问题的要求，并按相关性、展开、流利度和语言准确性分析回答。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 口语

points.label: 判断一个问题要求的回答内容
按评分要点判断一段回答的问题

sources.title: ETS：TOEFL iBT Test 2026 Update — Test Blueprint and Specifications
sources.used: 口语题型、题量、时间、话语功能和每题满分

sources.title: ETS：Updated TOEFL iBT Test Overview
sources.used: 口语任务说明、每题作答时间和面试评分标准

body.p: Take an Interview 先介绍情境，再播放预录的面试问题。同一话题共 4 个问题，每题作答 45 秒。前面的问题多问事实和经历，后面的问题要求表达并支持较广泛的观点。

body.box:
What activity did the group organize? Why was it useful?
Should more students take part in activities like this? Why?

body.p: 第一问要求说出活动及其作用，第二问要求立场和理由。回答要对应当前的问题，不能把同一段经历原样套用到每一问。

cards.title: 解题步骤
cards.note: 以上为本课程的建议，不是官方规定

steps.d: 识别疑问词、时间和并列的要求。What changed, and why? 同时问变化和原因，只说变化不算答完。
先给出直接答案，再补原因或例子。I prefer the morning session because I can concentrate before work. 选择和理由在同一句里。
在作答时间内继续补充与问题相关的细节，不用重复来凑时间。It helped me plan. 之后可以补 I divided the work into daily tasks，不再说 It was helpful。

cards.title: 问题的要求
rows: 事实
直接说出所问的对象。
What did the team build? → A portable display stand.
经历
说明具体事件和所问的结果。
What happened during setup? → A panel fell, so we replaced its support.
解释
说明原因，不只评价好坏。
Why was setup slow? → Each panel needed a separate support.
观点
给出立场和理由，可以不同意问句。
Should the stand be reused? → Yes, because the panels can be replaced.
建议
提出应采取的行动。
How could setup improve? → Label the supports before packing them.
预测
说明可能的变化和依据。
What might change? → Setup may become faster with labeled parts.

cards.title: 评分要点
rows: 切题与展开
回答问题，并给出相关的细节。
It helped. → It reduced errors because each part had a label.
连贯
细节和理由之间有联系，如用 so 连接。
I checked the list, so we found the missing hinge.
会话速度
停顿自然，不频繁中断。
I chose the kit because … because … it was … useful.
可懂度
发音、节奏和语调让听者听懂意思。
I ordered thirteen parts. 中的数量要能听清。
词汇与语法
用准确且有变化的语言表达具体含义。
Yesterday we replace it. → Yesterday we replaced it.
综合判断
看整段回答，不凭一个错误定分。
We replaced the hinge. 一句话不足以判断整段表现。

body.box:
Question: What did organizing the food collection teach the team?
Response: We collected food. It was a food collection. Our team collected a lot of food.

Which weakness is supported by the transcript?
1. It gives a lesson but no collection details.
2. It repeats the activity without stating what was learned.
3. It explains a lesson using unrelated collection details.
4. It states that the team learned too many lessons.

body.p: 问题问的是 teach the team。第二项正确：回答三次说 collected food，没有说学到了什么。

body.box: We learned to divide responsibilities. One member checked dates while another sorted the boxes, so fewer packages had to be handled twice.

body.p: 改写先说学到的 divide responsibilities，再讲具体分工和结果。

cards.title: 干扰项
rows: 只答一半
Why join, and what changed? → I joined to meet people.
核对 and 后的第二项要求。
用重复代替展开
It was useful. It was very useful.
看两句是否给出不同的信息。
偏离当前问题
What was learned? → The collection was on Friday.
问的是收获，回答的是日期。
无依据的评分判断
清楚的文字稿 → 发音一定清楚。
文字稿看不出发音。
过度概括
一次时态错误 → 整段无法理解。
看完整回答，再判断错误的影响。

groups.text: Question: Why did the reading circle change its meeting place, and how did members respond? Response: The old room was noisy.

options: The reason for leaving the old room
The members' reaction to the change
The identity of the meeting activity
The condition of the original room
items.why: The old room was noisy 回答了 Why，how did members respond 还没有回答，即第二项。

groups.text: Question: What made the archive project difficult? Response: Several labels were missing, so we had to compare the entries with earlier lists.

options: It states that every label was missing.
It describes the comparison but gives no cause.
It links missing information to extra work.
It says the earlier lists were incomplete.
items.why: Several labels were missing 是困难，so we had to compare … 是它带来的额外工作，即第三项。回答没有说早期清单不完整。

groups.text: Question: Should the rehearsal be moved outdoors? Explain a possible drawback as well as a benefit.

items.stem: Which response plan meets both requirements?
options: Give one benefit of the move and one possible drawback.
Describe the current room and repeat its location.
List outdoor activities and describe the rehearsal music.
Recommend moving and repeat the recommendation.
items.why: 问题要求 a possible drawback as well as a benefit，第一项利和弊都有。第四项只推荐搬迁，没有弊端。

groups.text: Question: Why keep a shared calendar? Response: It is useful. A shared calendar is useful. I find calendars useful.

items.stem: Which weakness can be established from these words?
options: The response gives conflicting calendar dates.
The response cannot be understood because of pronunciation.
The response explains a benefit for the wrong group.
The response only repeats a judgment and names no benefit.
items.why: 三次 useful 都只是评价，没有说明共享日历的作用，即第四项。文字稿看不出发音问题。

groups.text: Question: What changed after the dance group began recording rehearsals, and why did that matter? Response: We noticed that our entrances were uneven. Watching the recording showed exactly where we lost time, so we practiced those sections separately.

items.stem: Which information does the question require?
options: The date when the group first began recording its rehearsals
Only the problem that the recordings revealed
A change in the group's awareness and its value
The sections each member practiced alone
items.why: What changed 和 why did that matter 要求说出变化和它的作用，即第三项。第二项只说了问题，少了作用。

items.stem: Why is the answer more developed than 'The recordings helped'?
options: It explains a specific problem and the action taken.
It repeats the value of recording in different words.
It discusses every possible use of recordings.
It gives the recording date and the rehearsal time.
items.why: 回答先说 entrances were uneven，再说 practiced those sections separately，把问题和行动连了起来，即第一项。

items.stem: Complete the sentence stating the specific problem.
items.why: We noticed 引出具体的发现，were uneven 说明发现了什么。

lines.text: I joined the glass workshop because I wanted to learn a practical skill. The instructor showed me how to handle the tools safely.

items.stem: The interviewer asks why the speaker joined and what the instructor taught. What must the answer cover?
options: A reason for joining and the instruction received
A description of tools and their purchase prices
A comparison of instructors and their practical skills
A workshop timetable and a list of participants
items.why: why 问加入的原因，what 问教了什么，第一项两点都有。

items.stem: Which assessment is supported by the response?
options: It states the joining reason but leaves the instruction unspecified.
It explains the instruction but contradicts the joining reason.
It describes safety without answering either part of the question.
It answers both parts with a specific reason and teaching detail.
items.why: learn a practical skill 回答了原因，handle the tools safely 回答了所学，即第四项。

items.stem: Rebuild the first sentence that was heard.
items.why: because I wanted to learn a practical skill 说明加入的原因。although 表示让步，关系不对。

items.stem: Rebuild the second sentence that was heard.
items.why: showed me how to handle the tools safely 是具体的教学内容。修饰 handle 用副词 safely。

lines.text: I think bicycle repair training is valuable. It is valuable because it is useful.

items.stem: The interviewer asks whether bicycle repair training should be offered and why. Which plan meets that request?
options: List the repair tools and their storage locations.
State a position and explain a benefit of the training.
Describe an instructor and repeat the training title.
Give the course dates and compare the repair rooms.
items.why: whether … should be offered and why 要求立场和理由，即第二项。

options: It supports training but recommends canceling it.
It describes a practical repair unrelated to the training.
It repeats a positive judgment without identifying a benefit.
It gives several benefits without choosing between them.
items.why: valuable 和 useful 都是笼统的评价，第二句没有说出具体用处，即第三项。

items.stem: Rebuild the first sentence that was heard.
items.why: I think 引出立场。主语 training 是单数，用 is。

items.stem: Rebuild the second sentence that was heard.
items.why: 原句是 It is valuable because it is useful。有 because，但后面仍是评价，不是理由。
